questions.question: Jesus told His disciples it was for their benefit that He was going away. What reason did He give?

answers.text: He would send the Advocate to them
They would learn to lead on their own
The world would stop hating them

questions.question: Jesus told His disciples they would weep and grieve while the world rejoiced. What did He say their grief would turn into?
In His last talk with His disciples, Jesus said an hour had come. What did He say they would do?

answers.text: Scatter and leave Him all alone
Stand beside Him to the end

questions.question: Jesus told His disciples they would have trouble in the world. Why did He say they could take courage?

answers.text: The world will come to love them
